source.title: Integrable representations of Kac-Moody algebras: Results and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 66790. Local shard metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-1.csv identified the exact work as 'Integrable representations of Kac-Moody algebras: Results and open problems' from 1989; exact-title web results identified the host volume as 'Infinite Dimensional Lie Algebras And Groups' and the authors as V. Chari and A. Pressley.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/66790 returned HTTP/2 403 with cf-mitigated: challenge, so the zbMATH page body could not be used as readable technical source text.

Identifier-specific recovery attempted zbMATH REST API endpoints for document 66790 and an:66790, but the local fetch environment could not resolve api.zbmath.org. The cached API schema confirmed those endpoints are metadata services only; no readable full-text artifact was recovered through the API path.
evidence_refs: curl: Could not resolve host: api.zbmath.org

trace.notes: Bounded exact-work search inspected exact-title, exact-title plus PDF, and title-author queries. Google Books and Google Play confirmed only bibliographic and table-of-contents information for the host volume, not the full chapter text. The World Scientific host-volume page returned HTTP/2 403 in local fetch. Cambridge Core, ResearchGate, author CV, and thesis/reference candidates were rejected because they exposed only citations, references, snippets, or different works rather than the exact readable problem statements.

No candidate questions were extracted because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. Resolver metadata, abstracts, search snippets, references, and book table-of-contents pages were not used as extraction evidence.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/66790.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
